profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your picture and how your account is set up on this server.
profile.pictureHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB, cropped to a square.
profile.notAnImage: Choose an image file (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF).
profile.removeMessage: Remove your profile picture? Your initials show instead.

editor.label: Editor
editor.desc: can also fix titles, covers and details

security.title: Security
security.description: Your password, two-factor sign-in, and the devices signed in as you.

password.desc: Changing it signs you out everywhere, this browser included.
password.changed: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.desc: A code from your phone as well as your password. Worth it if you use Plinthio away from home.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.desc: Every phone, browser and TV you've signed in on keeps you signed in. If you've signed in somewhere you no longer control, sign out everywhere.
devices.confirmMessage: Every device signed in to this account will be signed out straight away, including this one.
devices.signOutFailed: Could not sign out of all devices

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: What's on your shelves and where Plinthio opens. Saves as you go.

mediaTypes.title: Media types
mediaTypes.desc: Which kinds of media appear on your shelves. Keep at least one.

views.title: Shelf views
views.desc: The views above your shelf. Each shows one card per series; Alphabetical is always there.

alphabetical.label: Alphabetical
alphabetical.desc: Always on. Every series and title A–Z.

creator.label: Creator
creator.desc: Grouped by author, director or studio.

customFolders.label: Custom folders
customFolders.desc: Your own in-app folders, with an Unorganized catch-all.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: What you'd rather not see. Only your account changes, and anything can come back any time.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.desc: Switch a library off and nothing from it shows up for you: not on your shelves, in search, or in your reading and sync apps.

kids.label: Kids content
kids.desc: Kids libraries, and any title your admin added to Kids Mode.

titles.title: Hidden titles
titles.desc: Titles you've hidden from their pages.

hidden.empty: Nothing hidden. Hide a title from its page and it shows up here.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: What you've read, watched and listened to, and your recent sign-ins.

apps.title: Apps & API keys
apps.description: Use Plinthio from reading apps, scripts and dashboards. Each one signs in with an API key you make here.

reading.title: Reading apps
reading.desc: Read your comics, manga, PDFs and books in other apps. Sign in with your username ({username}) and an API key as the password. Make one key per app, so you can sign one out by deleting its key.
reading.mihon: Install the Komga extension, open its settings and enter this address, your username and an API key as the password. Then, in Mihon's Settings → Tracking, turn on Komga so what you read in Mihon marks it read here.
reading.koreader: Open a book, then Tools → Progress sync → Custom sync server: enter this address. Choose Login (not Register) with your username and an API key as the password. Your place in PDFs and comics syncs both ways; EPUB positions sync between KOReader devices, and Plinthio shows how far through you are. Keys made before Plinthio 1.0 don't work here — make a new one.
reading.opdsName: OPDS readers (Chunky, Panels, KyBook, Moon+ Reader)
reading.opds: Add this as an OPDS catalog, with your username and an API key as the password.

keys.title: API keys
keys.desc: A key acts as you. Send it in the {header} header, or use it as the password in an app.
keys.name: Key name
keys.namePlaceholder: What it's for, e.g. Mihon on my phone
keys.copyNow: Copy your new key now. It won't be shown again.
keys.revokeMessage: Revoke "{name}"? Anything using it is signed out straight away.
